headline: The appeal sits with the Fifth District Court of Appeals in Dallas — no argument date set
body:
Karmelo Anthony's direct appeal goes to the Court of Appeals for the Fifth District of Texas at Dallas — the state appellate court that takes appeals out of Collin County. Appellate counsel Donny Perales (Chesley & Perales) will file the opening brief. The Batson challenge — three Black prospective jurors struck before trial — and the rejected sudden-passion instruction are expected to be among the primary grounds. No argument date has been set; reporting notes an appeals hearing may not come until 2027.

CORRECTION, September 2, 2026: an earlier version of this entry said the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals had issued a briefing schedule, and listed an opening brief due October 15, a State's response due November 14 and a reply due December 1, citing the Fifth Circuit clerk's office. The Fifth Circuit is a federal court and has no role in this state appeal. Those deadlines could not be confirmed against the Fifth District's own docket and have been removed pending confirmation.
